items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 66:1
items.html: The filling of the names indicates the measure of the stature of the level. And the vowel points indicate the source of each particular level in the name — whether it is from the inclusion of the upper ones within it, or from the lower ones, or from its own aspect. (Page 313, Item 41; and in Etz Chaim, Gate 18, end of Chapter 1).
